title: Doozy Vape Co Doozy Legends Pineapple Raspberry Sangria 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape’s Pineapple Raspberry Sangria captures the deliciously sweet and refreshing experience that is a classic Spanish Sangria fruit punch. Rich, sunny Pineapples blended with sharp, tangy Raspberries with a subtle touch of ice for a refreshing finish. One vape and you’ll be booking your holidays! This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
